title: Amantii Teessoo Duuba
intro: Lubbuun tokko tokko ibiddaan ykn lolaadhaan osoo hin taane, dhiibbaa suuta suutaan masaraa abbaa irree keessa jiraachuun qoramti. Fakkiin kun bulchaa saba isaanii irratti waaqummaa himatu cinaa dhaabatee ture, ta’us dhoksaan Waaqa Dhugaa Tokkichatti amantiitti maxxane. Yeroo of kennuu isaanii argamu, gidiraan ni dhufe — garuu abdiin waaqaa akkasuma. Kun eenyu akka ta'e tilmaamu dandeessu?
clues: Bulchaa lafa koo isa humna guddaa qabu jala kanan jiraadhe siʼa taʼu, ejjennoo namoonni muraasni tilmaamu dandaʼan keessa ture.
Haati manaa koo ummata dura dhaabbattee waaqa ta’uu isaa labsite — garuu garaan koo kan Gooftaa Dhugaa Tokkicha ture.
Adabbii warra haadha manaa koo morman hunda irratti dhufu sodaadhee dhoksee kadhannaa xuxxuqeen ture.
Yeroo amantiin koo saaxilamu, qabamee dararamaa ture — ta’us arrabni koo jecha kufrii tokkollee dubbatee hin beeku.
Badii hunda irraa fagaatee jannata keessatti mana kadhadheen qalbii koo Rabbii kiyyaatti dhangalaase.
Ani Asiya bint Muzahim — haadha manaa Fara’oon Muusaa fi Harun mormteedha.

identity.label: Ani Eenyu?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Haadha manaa Fara'oon) .
Hawwaa (Hewaan), dubartii jalqabaa
Saaraan haadha manaa Ibrahim isa jalqabaa
Aggaar haadha Ismaa'il
Haadha Maariyaam (haadha warraa Imraan) .

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Amantii ganuu diduudhaan dararaa obsuu
Garaa qurxummii guddaa keessaa lubbuun jiraachuu
Lolaa jalaa miliquuf doonii guddaa ijaaruu
Ibidda boba’aa keessa darbatamuu
Gargar bahuu galaana guddaa dhugaa ba'uu

location.label: Qaama Ijoo
options: Jannata keessatti mana isaaniif ijaarame
Ulee gara bofaatti jijjiirame
Taabotni uumama hundumaa lama lama baatu
Re'ee warqee saba tokkoon waaqeffamu
Sling loltuu guddaa tokko injifachuuf itti fayyadaman

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Qajeeloota cinatti mana jireenyaa Jannata keessatti kabajame
Waraana isaanii waliin dalga jalatti liqimfaman
Abiddaan gubate garuu gidduu seenummaa waaqaatiin baraarame
Uumama guddaa tokkoon liqimfame sana booda qarqara galaanaatti darbatame
Nama sooressa bara isaanii ta'e
outcome.answer: Qajeeloota cinatti mana jireenyaa Jannata keessatti kabajame

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
